<function name="GetTextStyleColor" parent="DLabel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
<internal></internal>

Returns the "internal" or fallback color of the text.

See also <page>DLabel:GetTextColor</page> and <page>DLabel:SetTextStyleColor</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Color">The "internal" <page>Color</page> of the text</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
